description: Speech prices for the Rasa variant with Speechmatics speech-to-text and Deepgram Aura-2 text-to-speech (run_spec.py --speech-prices).

stt.billed: per second of audio streamed; the driver streams continuously, silence included
stt.source: speechmatics.com/pricing as recorded by examples/mantle-voice-banking-dispute-claude/README.md on 2026-09-29. On 2026-09-30 the page rendered a Pro price of 0.129 without a unit, so this row was not re-confirmed

tts.billed: per character synthesised; priced here on the bot text in the agent's conversation record, so a phrase served from Rasa's TTS cache is still counted (an upper bound)
tts.source: https://deepgram.com/pricing, pay as you go, read 2026-10-01: Aura-2 $0.030/1k characters
